_comment: The homepage partners strip. Each item needs a `name` — it is the image's alt text, and it renders as a wordmark when there is no logo file, so a partner can go up before their artwork arrives and nothing ever ships as a broken image. `logo` is a filename inside assets/partners/ (SVG or PNG). `url` is optional; with one the logo becomes a link.
heading: Our
lead: Brands we are proud to work alongside.
